# Panel group (`panel-group`)

Tabbed dock of panels.

Group: Layout & shells. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/layout';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createIconButton` (types in `dist/web/actions/iconButton.d.ts`): `.mh-icon-button`: a round, icon-only button at least a touch target wide.

```ts
export function createIconButton(options: IconButtonOptions): IconButtonHandle;

export interface IconButtonOptions {
  icon: IconName | string;
  /** Required: the button's accessible name (also its tooltip). */
  label: string;
  tone?: IconButtonTone;
  size?: IconButtonSize;
  /** A filled circle (raised surface) rather than a bare glyph. */
  filled?: boolean;
  /** Toggle buttons: sets `aria-pressed`. */
  pressed?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  onClick?: (event: MouseEvent) => void;
}

export interface IconButtonHandle {
  el: HTMLButtonElement;
  setIcon(icon: IconName | string): void;
  setPressed(pressed: boolean): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

`createPanelGroup` (types in `dist/web/layout/panelGroup.d.ts`): `.mh-panel-group` (`--flush`; `.is-collapsed`): a dock of panels behind a compact tab bar (`__bar` with a `role="tablist"` `__tabs` of `__tab` buttons, `__actions` and an optional `__fold` button) and one `role="tabpanel"` `__panel` per entry. Arrows, Home and End move between tabs; selecting a tab of a folded dock opens it.

```ts
export function createPanelGroup(options: PanelGroupOptions): PanelGroupHandle;

export interface PanelGroupOptions {
  panels: readonly PanelGroupItem[];
  /** Selected panel id; default the first enabled one. */
  value?: string;
  /** Accessible name of the tab list. */
  label?: string;
  /** Elements at the end of the tab bar (icon buttons). */
  actions?: HTMLElement[];
  /** A button at the end of the bar folds the dock down to its tabs. */
  collapsible?: boolean;
  collapsed?: boolean;
  /** Label of the fold button (default "Collapse panels" / "Expand panels"). */
  collapseLabel?: string;
  expandLabel?: string;
  /** Body without padding. */
  flush?: boolean;
  onChange?: (id: string) => void;
  onCollapse?: (collapsed: boolean) => void;
}

export interface PanelGroupHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  value(): string;
  setValue(id: string): void;
  collapsed(): boolean;
  setCollapsed(collapsed: boolean): void;
}

export interface PanelGroupItem {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  icon?: IconName | string;
  /** A count or short label after the tab text. */
  badge?: string | number;
  disabled?: boolean;
  content?: Child | Child[];
}
```

`createText` (types in `dist/web/foundations/text.d.ts`): `.mh-text--<variant>`: the type scale at the current device class.

```ts
export function createText(content: Child, options: TextOptions = {}): HTMLElement;

export interface TextOptions {
  variant?: TextVariant;
  tone?: TextTone;
  /** Element to render; default `p`, or `h1`–`h3` for display, headline and title. */
  as?: keyof HTMLElementTagNameMap;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createIconButton, createPanelGroup, createText } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const refresh = createIconButton({ icon: 'refresh', label: 'Refresh' });

const dock = createPanelGroup({
  label: 'Diagnostics',
  panels: [
    { id: 'events', label: 'Events', icon: 'bell', badge: 2, content: createText('Motion in the hall at 14:02.') },
    { id: 'devices', label: 'Devices', icon: 'wifi', content: createText('12 devices online, 1 asleep.') },
    { id: 'logs', label: 'Logs', icon: 'info', content: createText('Heartbeat at 14:05.', { variant: 'mono' }) },
  ],
  value: 'events',
  actions: [refresh.el],
  collapsible: true,
  onChange: (id) => refresh.setDisabled(id === 'logs'),
});

document.body.append(dock.el);
```

## React API

`IconButton` (types in `dist/react/actions.d.ts`): Same DOM and classes as `createIconButton`.

```ts
export function IconButton({ icon, label, tone, size, filled, pressed, className, ...rest }: IconButtonProps);

export interface IconButtonProps extends Omit<ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>, 'children'> {
  icon: IconName | string;
  /** Required: the accessible name (also the tooltip). */
  label: string;
  tone?: IconButtonTone;
  size?: IconButtonSize;
  filled?: boolean;
  pressed?: boolean;
}
```

`PanelGroup` (types in `dist/react/layout.d.ts`): Same DOM and classes as `createPanelGroup`. `value` and `collapsed` are followed when they change.

```ts
export function PanelGroup({ panels, value, label, actions, collapsible = false, collapsed = false, collapseLabel, expandLabel, flush, onChange, onCollapse, className }: PanelGroupProps);

export interface PanelGroupProps {
  panels: readonly PanelGroupPanel[];
  value?: string;
  label?: string;
  actions?: ReactNode;
  collapsible?: boolean;
  collapsed?: boolean;
  collapseLabel?: string;
  expandLabel?: string;
  flush?: boolean;
  onChange?: (id: string) => void;
  onCollapse?: (collapsed: boolean) => void;
  className?: string;
}
```

`Text` (types in `dist/react/foundations.d.ts`)

```ts
export function Text({ variant = 'body', tone, as, className, children, ...rest }: TextProps);

export interface TextProps extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> {
  variant?: TextVariant;

  as?: string;
  children?: ReactNode;
}
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { IconButton, PanelGroup, Text } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

export function PanelGroupExample() {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState('events');
  const [collapsed, setCollapsed] = useState(false);
  return (
    <PanelGroup
      label="Diagnostics"
      panels={[
        { id: 'events', label: 'Events', icon: 'bell', badge: 2, content: <Text>Motion in the hall at 14:02.</Text> },
        { id: 'devices', label: 'Devices', icon: 'wifi', content: <Text>12 devices online, 1 asleep.</Text> },
        { id: 'logs', label: 'Logs', icon: 'info', content: <Text variant="mono">Heartbeat at 14:05.</Text> },
      ]}
      value={tab}
      onChange={setTab}
      actions={<IconButton icon="refresh" label="Refresh" disabled={tab === 'logs'} />}
      collapsible
      collapsed={collapsed}
      onCollapse={setCollapsed}
    />
  );
}
```
